source_snapshot.items: Updated GPU firmware will activate on AC power cycle
source_snapshot.procedure: Generic DGX bundle upload to HGX_0, task wait, AC cycle, inventory check.

old_problem: HGX_0 and generic DGX inventory do not identify GPUs, boards, banks, image or target versions.
disposition_reason: ED-07 preserves flash plus pre/post version checks, but destructive target/image/activation/rollback semantics cannot be guessed from generic Redfish.
decision_basis: Read all 18 row264 cells and history2864.
Preserved GPU firmware and AC activation coverage.
No upload, flash or cycle occurred.

test_case.test_name: GPU firmware update with AC activation
test_case.purpose: Update every approved GPU firmware target through the mapped HGX endpoint, activate by authorized AC cycle and verify active versions and health.
required_package: Stable power, rollback and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After independent flash approval, inventory GPUs, verify image/targets, submit one scoped task, preserve status, authorize AC OFF-ON-OS-ready, then verify each GPU active version and health.
test_case.expected_result: Only approved GPUs reach exact target versions after activation with no task, boot, link or GPU error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Generic HGX task completion or bundle version alone is insufficient.
test_case.recovery: Do not AC-cycle after failed task; use vendor rollback/OOB recovery and preserve evidence.

source_conflict.reason: GPU scope is not mapped to generic HGX_0/DGX inventory.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Supply GPU target map, signed image/versions, activation and rollback.

project_authority: GPU bundle mapping and recovery are OEM-specific.
